name: Tokushu Tokai Paper Co., Ltd.
summary: Tokushu Tokai Paper Co., Ltd. manufactures, processes, and sells paper products in Japan. It offers special material products, such as fancy, high-grade printer, canvas, functional, security, and information-use papers, as well as papers for protection and preservation. The company also provides industrial material products comprising containerboards, kraft papers, and converting papers.
